verdict.rationale: There is no explicit retention or deletion control in the evidence; partial credit rests only on indirect signals. Steel can be self-hosted from an open-source Docker image, which would keep data under the user's control. Sessions are isolated with their own state and can be stopped, and there are API endpoints for managing Files, though deletion is never stated. Missing for 10: documented retention policies or configurable retention windows, explicit deletion of session data, recordings, traces and files, account-level data purge, and any independent corroboration.
